    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(review_score ORDER BY review_answer_timestamp DESC), ',', 1) AS last_score
  FROM order_reviews
  GROUP BY order_id
) x
WHERE first_score <> last_score;

  DATE_FORMAT(review_answer_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  review_score,
  AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, review_creation_date, review_answer_timestamp)) AS avg_response_hours
FROM order_reviews

  AND review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(review_comment_message) <> ''
